markdown_summary: Scripted baseline submitted the seeded findings for this surface.

verified_safe.control: deposit compares the predecessor to the owner
verified_safe.evidence: src/lib.rs:25 asserts caller == owner before crediting the balance

findings.title: Missing owner check in withdraw
findings.impact: Any account that can call the contract can reduce the recorded balance.
findings.preconditions: The contract holds a nonzero balance.
findings.analysis: withdraw subtracts amount at src/lib.rs:30 and never reads predecessor_account_id, unlike deposit.
findings.validation: Source inspection of src/lib.rs. No existing test covers this method.
findings.fix: Require the predecessor account to equal the stored owner before changing the balance.

findings.title: ft_on_transfer does not check the token contract
findings.impact: A caller other than the fungible-token contract can credit the vault balance.
findings.analysis: ft_on_transfer adds amount.0 to balance at src/lib.rs:42 and does not compare predecessor_account_id to a stored token account.
findings.validation: Source inspection of src/lib.rs. No existing test covers this method.
findings.fix: Store the fungible-token account and reject calls whose predecessor is not that account.

findings.title: Client stores the account secret in localStorage
findings.impact: Any script that can read the page origin can copy the key.
findings.preconditions: The page calls account() with a secret.
findings.analysis: account writes the secret string to localStorage at client/src/wallet.ts:4 before constructing a KeyPair.
findings.fix: Keep the key in memory for the session and do not write it to localStorage.
